name: NCAA D-I Mountain Regional Cross Country Championships
headline: NCAA D-I Mountain Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 7 New Mexico won the women’s race with 45 points as Pamela Kosgei (19:08.3), Mercy Kirarei and Marion Jepngetich went 1-2-3, with No. 6 Northern Arizona second (67) and No. 1 BYU third (81). No. 1 New Mexico also took the men’s title, 35 to 42 over No. 2 Colorado, with No. 6 BYU third (65). Texas Tech’s Titus Kimaru won the men’s race in 28:41.9.
